200.description: The report for the effective range.

dock_to_stock_target_seconds.description: The dock-to-stock target the days' `share_under_target` is measured against, 11160 s (3.1 h, WERC best-in-class; ADR 0021).

days.description: One row per UTC day intersecting the range, in day order, zeros included.

receipts_closed.description: Receipts whose close fell in the day's window.

lines_received.description: Receiving actions against a line (`ReceiptLineReceived`) in the window.

units_good.description: Units received in `Good` condition in the window.

units_damaged.description: Units received in `Damaged` condition in the window.

discrepancies.description: Discrepancies of the receipts closed in the window, by kind.
discrepancies.title: DiscrepancyCounts

receipt_cycle.description:
A duration summary in seconds: how many durations there were and their
linear-interpolated median and 95th percentile. The percentiles are
null when `count` is 0.
receipt_cycle.title: TimingSummary

appointments.description: Appointment milestones that fell in the window.
appointments.title: AppointmentCounts

dock_dwell.description:
A duration summary in seconds: how many durations there were and their
linear-interpolated median and 95th percentile. The percentiles are
null when `count` is 0.
dock_dwell.title: TimingSummary

dock_to_stock.description:
The dock-to-stock facts (ADR 0021) of the receipts whose last Good
carton was stowed in the window: gate arrival to last stow, in
seconds, never negative.

share_under_target.description: under_target / count; null when count is 0.

dock_to_stock.title: DockToStockSummary

advice.description:
The receiving advices (ADR 0023) issued in the window: how many, and how
many inside the committed window after the last unit received
(`RECEIVING_ADVICE_SLA`, default 24 h). The KPI "% receipts with advice
inside the SLA" is `share_within_sla`.

count.description: Advices issued (`ReceivingAdviceIssued`) in the window, by the UTC day of their `issued_at`.

within_sla.description: Of those, how many had `within_sla` true.

share_within_sla.description: within_sla / count; null when count is 0.

advice.title: AdviceSummary

asn_timeliness.description:
The day's per-supplier ASN timeliness (ADR 0025), biggest
`registered` first, ties by `supplier_ref` ascending, at most the
top ten suppliers of the day; `[]` when none registered.

items.description:
One supplier's ASN timeliness of a day (ADR 0025): how many of the
day's ASNs were registered for it (counted in the UTC day of the ASN's
`registered_at`) and how many of those were registered after the visit
they were received under had arrived (`AsnLateForArrival`). The KPI
"% ASNs received before arrival" is `share_on_time`.

supplier_ref.description: The supplier the ASNs were registered for.

registered.description: ASNs of this supplier registered in the day (by `registered_at`).

late.description: Of those, how many were late for their visit's arrival.

share_on_time.description: 1 - late / registered; null when registered is 0.

items.title: SupplierTimeliness

open_receipts.description: Receipts opened and not yet closed.

expected_today.description: ASNs not cancelled whose expected arrival falls in today's UTC day.

expected_today_started.description: Of those, the ASNs that already have a receipt opened.

400.description: `from` / `to` are not RFC 3339, empty or inverted, or span more than 366 days.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

example.title: from and to must form a valid RFC 3339 range of at most 366 days
example.detail: from must be strictly before to

500.description: The analytical database query failed (the cause is logged, never returned).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

example.title: The report could not be served
